data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable data observed in the canonical data directory.

budget.rationale: Durable data storage budget measured and governed on 2026-08-05; the byte ceiling prevents unbounded growth without permitting automatic deletion.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces are declared from observed canonical scenario directories; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

service.name: business-health
service.description: Validates, visualizes, and scaffolds every scenario's business contract: PRD.md and requirements/ — template conformance, intent linkage, evidence-backed traceability, and deterministic remediation.

search-hub.description: Federated search router. business-health self-registers its `business-health.intent` provider (PRD purpose/OTs + requirements corpus) at boot so search-hub can route capability/intent queries to it.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: If search-hub is down at boot, self-registration retries briefly then gives up; local validation, matrix, wizard, and fleet surfaces are unaffected and registration is retried on next boot.

qdrant.description: Vector database for the business-health.intent search corpus (PRD overviews, operational targets, requirements).
qdrant.degraded_behavior: Intent search is unavailable; contract validation, traceability matrix, wizard, and fleet views work fully without it.

ollama.description: Local embedding role for intent-corpus index generation.
ollama.degraded_behavior: Embedding generation is unavailable; index refresh is deferred until the resource returns.

reranker.description: Cross-encoder reranker that reorders the dense intent-search shortlist (rerank enabled by design decision D5).
reranker.degraded_behavior: Reranking falls back to raw dense (cosine) order; results return with less precise final ordering.
